# Ada — a shop with a chat-run admin

A Nigerian small-shop **storefront** and its **vendor admin dashboard**, in one
offline HTML file. The vendor types `red bag 12k` or `add 20 to the ankara gown`
into the chat; the assistant shows a confirm card with the before → after value
and writes nothing until the vendor taps Confirm. Every change lands in an audit
log with one-tap undo.

- **Storefront** — open `index.html`, or the live link in the sidebar
- **Vendor admin** — `#/admin` · user `adaeze` · password `demo1234`
- **The chat** — `#/admin/chat`, then type `red bag 12k`

**No AI, no server, no network calls, no dependencies.** The "understanding" is a
deterministic rule engine; the images are drawn from the product's own name; the
whole page is 251 KB of text. State lives in the
browser's localStorage. Works from a phone, a laptop, or a USB stick.

This repository holds the built demo file only. Screenshots are in
[`screenshots/`](screenshots/).
